scope: Actual DOM default-state geometry, theme selection and responsive width. Does not establish pixel equality or transactional acceptance.
interpretationNotes: Before-fix observations are retained. Use the latest matching route/theme/viewport observation for the final matrix; raw flags alone are not the verdict.
110 records taken against a different selected viewport target were discarded; every retained verified-breakpoint record asserts actual width and height against the requested pair.
Brand/help MEME mobile +4px and purchase-create 701px address-option overflow were fixed and rerun. VIP loading failure flash and same-account wallet duplicate-read failure were fixed and rerun.

IM navy-coral one sample was a brief background refresh/loading state; the later same-theme observation settled with loading=false. No message was sent; opening an existing conversation may update its read watermark.
Checkout success first inspected a seller-visible order and correctly rejected customer ownership. The later real customer-owned order loaded its existing payment result; no payment was initiated.
27 desktop theme defaults plus 11 MEME viewport defaults do not establish all-theme-by-all-width pixel equality, all interactive/error states, animations or real transactional acceptance.
Buyer wallet operation modals were checked at four actual viewport pairs with focus containment and Escape; they were not run through 27 themes.
No credentials, browser cookies, authentication storage, wallet signing, funds transfers or message content were used in this DOM artifact.
